**Finding submitted: MISSING (medium severity, transition)**

**Gap.** Section 4 (p0024–p0029) covers only term, 90-day termination notice and the Termination Payment. Nothing in the Agreement addresses exit, even though HDI hosts the Site on its own server (§1.3), holds our Content and administers it (§1.4/2.1), and is exposed to our "Content, user information, data" as Confidential Information (§8.1). Section 8 has no return-or-destroy obligation, and the survival clause (§10.7) covers only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10. On termination we would have no right to migration help and no right to get our site content, customer or order data back — squarely the playbook's missing-transition scenario for a hosting agreement.

**Redline (validated ok:true).** New Section 4.3 inserted after p0029, in the termination section, at the preferred position: (a) up to six (6) months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, including migration cooperation; (b) return of Content, user information and customer/order data within thirty (30) days in a commonly used, machine-readable format; (c) deletion thereafter with written certification; plus express survival, since §10.7 would not otherwise carry it. The 90-day assistance fallback is flagged in the comment as a trade if HDI resists the six-month tail.
